quote.text: Lo, to-day is the last; if not, it is near the last.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that each day with your children is unique; cherish every moment as if it were irreplaceable.
    • Embrace the urgency of now by nurturing young lives with intentional actions and love, knowing tomorrow is never guaranteed.
  • Leadership
    • Lead by example, understanding that the present is the most potent time to influence change and inspire others.
    • Seize each moment with purpose and decisiveness, for every day holds the potential to leave a lasting impact on your followers.
  • Product Management
    • View development cycles as precious opportunities; prioritize actionable progress today rather than postponing success for tomorrow.
    • Adopt a mindset of urgency and continuous improvement, ensuring that each product iteration is delivered with the knowledge that time is of the essence.
